name: model-picker
description: Click to switch between the models your gateway (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) offers, right in the prompt.

showBand.title: Show the model band
showBand.description: Draw the current model and a Switch button above the prompt.

paneRows.title: Pane height

refreshMinutes.title: Model list freshness
refreshMinutes.description: Minutes before the model list is fetched again. 0 fetches on every open.
